gates.description: TXID format/source, known/unknown/pending/confirmed states and missing fields are explicit.
Current address scope, 100 network/30 address limit, reward exclusion and recovery limits documented.

invariants: The wallet stays non-custodial; seeds and private keys remain local and never enter run evidence.
Wallet/Mining and Block Explorer remain separate applications; Explorer observes FAE and never authorizes it.
Transaction creation or broadcast acceptance never implies confirmation.
Read failures, invalid payloads and a bounded empty result never prove absence of lifetime activity.
History follows the active address; stale responses may not replace a newer address or request.
Copy success means the exact validated full TXID was written successfully; manual selection remains available.
A durable local receipt is only a scoped cache of submission metadata, never network state or recovered history.
Independent verification uses separate methods/processes; one operator is sufficient.
Project status separates implemented, validated, integrated main, combined-main verified and live.
Parallelize independent files; serialize core.js, wallet.js, index.html and canonical integration.
